D: In the wasteland, a loner helps a fuel-rich compound break through a siege.
P: Serve the snacks when Max eats his tinned dinner.
S: Max eats from a tin, and it's not people food
Tins of corned beef hash: corned beef, diced potato and onion fried hard until crisp, served in clean tins with a fried egg.
the kid with the metal boomerang
Shortbread cut into boomerang shapes, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, edges dipped in dark chocolate.
the snake that guards his chopper
Long frankfurt wrapped in puff pastry in a coil, egg washed, sesame seeds on top, baked at 200C for 20 minutes. Mustard.
M: food for the people in the compound
Lamb shoulder rubbed with salt, garlic, rosemary and paprika, roasted low at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Flatbreads, yoghurt and tomato salad.
a big pot for the drive
Beef chuck browned in batches, onion, carrot, tomato and stock, braised 3 hours. Damper on the side, cooked in a camp oven.
W: Scone dough dumplings dropped into simmering golden syrup and butter, covered and cooked 20 minutes, served with cream.
K: dark, cold and precious in the wasteland
Cola poured over a glass packed with ice and a squeeze of lime, or 45ml dark rum with it for the adults.

edition.cue: Serve the snacks when Max eats his tinned dinner.

s.note: Crisp corned beef hash with a fried egg, served in clean tins.
s.how: Dice 400g potatoes and boil 6 minutes, then drain. Fry 1 diced brown onion in 30g butter, add the potato and 340g corned beef broken up, press flat and fry without stirring until crusty, then turn and repeat. Fry 4 eggs. Serve the hash in clean empty tins with an egg on top.

s.note: Shortbread boomerangs with dark chocolate-dipped edges.
s.how: Beat 200g soft butter with 100g icing sugar, then mix in 300g plain flour to a dough. Roll 5mm thick, cut into boomerang shapes and bake at 160C for 15 minutes until pale gold. Cool and dip the tips in 100g melted dark chocolate.

m.note: Slow-roasted pulled lamb shoulder with flatbreads, yoghurt and tomatoes.
m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with 4 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tbsp chopped rosemary, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tsp salt. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Serve with 8 warm flatbreads, 250g Greek yoghurt and a salad of 4 chopped tomatoes with red onion.

w.note: Scone dumplings simmered in golden syrup butter sauce, with cream.
w.how: Rub 40g butter into 250g self-raising flour, mix in 150ml milk to a soft dough and roll into 12 balls. Bring 250ml water, 100g golden syrup, 100g brown sugar and 40g butter to a simmer in a wide pan. Drop in the dumplings, cover and cook 20 minutes without lifting the lid. Serve with 200ml cream.

d.note: Cola over ice with lime, with dark rum for the adults.
d.how: Fill four glasses with ice and squeeze a wedge of lime into each, using 2 limes. Top with cold cola, about 1.25 litres in total. For the adults, add 45ml dark rum to the glass first.
